meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大目标拆成可验证的步骤,循环执行直到收尾。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常有需要持续推进的大目标,希望分解执行、随时掌握进度。
copy.tagline_en: Break big goals into verified steps and loop through them until completion.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a big goal to pursue and need to split it into small, trackable steps.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会以“目标循环”方式工作：先注册目标，把任务拆成极细步骤并逐条更新进度；按需派子代理并行执行，且每个成功标准都要附真实证据，按检查点持续推进。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-loop”或“ulw”，或要求进行带检查点的长期交付、证据驱动的工作时，该技能会被触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把这个任务拆成可检查步骤并执行。
say.note: Claude会先读流程并注册目标，再逐步推进。

say.text: 启动一个带检查点的长期循环，每步都要有证据。
say.note: 它会按目标循环工作，并为每步记录验证证据。

say.text: 拆分任务成原子步骤，让子代理并行推进并验证结果。
say.note: 它将委派多个子代理，并汇总各自的证据。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a goal loop: register the goal, break work into fine-grained steps, update progress live, delegate code/QA to subagents, and require real evidence for each success criterion before checkpointing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'ulw-loop' or 'ulw', or asks for durable, checkpointed long-running delivery with evidence-led work.

say_en.text: Plan and run this project as an ulw-loop with checkable steps.
say_en.note: It reads the workflow first and registers goals.

say_en.text: Start a long-running goal loop with checkpoints and evidence for each step.
say_en.note: It tracks every atomic action and records proof.

say_en.text: Split this into atomic steps and run them with subagents in parallel.
say_en.note: It spawns workers and validates their output.
